translated_title: Economic Package Will Seek to Combat Evasion and Avoidance by Shell-Invoice Firms
original_title: Paquete económico buscará combatir evasión y elusión de factureras
author: Contralínea Editorial Staff
meta_description: Mexico's 2027 Economic Package aims to lift tax revenue to a record 15.9% of GDP with no new taxes, by fighting evasion, avoidance, and shell-invoice firms (factureras).
